# OER Commons

> > OER Commons is a digital library and collaborative network for discovering, sharing, and curating open educational resources aligned to standards.

OER Commons, operated by ISKME, serves educators and institutions worldwide by providing access to freely available educational materials and connecting communities around open education practice. The platform features curated collections, subject-specific hubs, and tools for authoring and collaboration.

## Key Topics

- Open Educational Resources (OER)
- Open Author
- Common Core Standards
- Next Generation Science Standards (NGSS)
- Digital Library
- Community Hubs

## Discover & Browse Resources

- [Browse OER Materials](https://oercommons.org/oer): Browse and discover open educational resources by subject, type, and filters
- [Curated Collections](https://oercommons.org/curated-collections): Curated OER collections aligned to Common Core and NGSS standards
- [Browse Providers](https://oercommons.org/oer/providers): Directory of OER content providers and institutional partners

## Community Hubs & Networks

- [Network Hubs](https://oercommons.org/hubs): Directory of OER Commons hubs and collaborative learning communities
- [#GoOpen Network](https://oercommons.org/hubs/GoOpen): #GoOpen Network hub for open education community and membership
- [Climate Education Hub](https://oercommons.org/hubs/climate): Climate education hub with NGSS-aligned resources for K-16 educators
- [AI & OER Community Hub](https://oercommons.org/hubs/ai-in-oer): Community hub for AI and OER with events calendar and resources
- [PowerED by National Geographic Society](https://oercommons.org/hubs/national-geographic-society): National Geographic Society OER hub with interactive learning resources
- [Pharmacy Tools for Contraceptive Choice](https://oercommons.org/hubs/f-p-for-pharmacy): Pharmacy education hub for contraceptive training in global health

## Community Groups

- [Community Groups Directory](https://oercommons.org/groups): Directory of community groups for collaborative learning and subject filtering
- [Adult Education Open Community of Resources](https://oercommons.org/groups/adult-education-open-community-of-resources/45): Adult education group resources for ESL and English language learning
- [Pathways Project: Language Teaching Repository](https://oercommons.org/groups/pathways-project-language-teaching-repository-bois/2388): Boise State language teaching repository with Arabic conversation resources
- [Student Advocacy Group](https://oercommons.org/groups/student-advocacy/3810): Student advocacy group promoting OER cost savings and institutional support

## About & Support

- [About OER Commons](https://oercommons.org/about): About OER Commons: mission, ISKME organization, and open education practice
- [Help Center](https://oercommons.org/help-center): Help center with guides for searching, content creation, and resource submission
- [Hubs Documentation](https://oercommons.org/about-hubs): Documentation about OER hubs, curation, LTI integration, and collaboration

## Home

- [OER Commons Homepage](https://oercommons.org): OER Commons homepage: digital library and network for open educational resources
